title: Ordinary scalar units and coefficient naturality
statement: For the ordinary normalized restriction and coefficient comparisons of a coefficient square, scalar association commutes with the scalar extension units. Comparisons of the underlying coefficient modules commute with compatible maps of ring sheaves represented by their actual sectionwise module maps.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: Precompose with the inverse-image generator of the identity. The invertible structural coefficient makes this an isomorphism. Generator naturality and the scalar-association generator equation prove the unit square.

The sectionwise hypotheses identify the underlying module maps with the ring maps. Precompose by the identity generator, apply the two coefficient normalization equations and cancel. The assumed ring square gives the desired equality.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.

theorem coefficient_naturality
    (f : RingedPullback.{u, u, u, u, u} R S)
    (k : Comparison.{u, u, u, u, u} f)
    [IsIso f.coefficient]
    (d d' : CoefficientSquare.{u, u, u, u, u} f)
    (beta : f.L.obj (coefficient d.sourceMap) ≅ coefficient d.targetMap)
    (beta' : f.L.obj (coefficient d'.sourceMap) ≅ coefficient d'.targetMap)
    (hb : ∀ (Z : Sheaf K (Type u))
      (x : Z ⟶ (underlying.{u, u, u} R).obj (coefficient d.sourceMap)),
      generator f k x ≫ (underlying.{u, u, u} S).map beta.hom =
        f.uInv.map x ≫ d.I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map d.coefficient')
    (hb' : ∀ (Z : Sheaf K (Type u))
      (x : Z ⟶ (underlying.{u, u, u} R).obj (coefficient d'.sourceMap)),
      generator f k x ≫ (underlying.{u, u, u} S).map beta'.hom =
        f.uInv.map x ≫ d'.I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
          (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map d'.coefficient')
    (psiY : d.R' ⟶ d'.R') (psiX : d.S' ⟶ d'.S')
    (hc : f.uInv.map ((sheafCompose K (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map psiY) ≫
      d'.I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
        (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map d'.coefficient' =
      d.I'.ringUnderlying.hom ≫
        (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map d.coefficient' ≫
        (sheafCompose L (forget CommRingCat.{u})).map psiX)
    (hY : coefficient d.sourceMap ⟶ coefficient d'.sourceMap)
    (hX : coefficient d.targetMap ⟶ coefficient d'.targetMap)
    (hy : ∀ (V : Cᵒᵖ) (b : d.R'.obj.obj V), hY.val.app V b = psiY.hom.app V b)
    (hx : ∀ (V : Dᵒᵖ) (b : d.S'.obj.obj V), hX.val.app V b = psiX.hom.app V b) :
    f.L.map hY ≫ beta'.hom = beta.hom ≫ hX
